messages:
Emily Nguyen: Hi all — Lynx tenant scheduled switchover tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Posting quick checklist and asking for final sign-off.
Rajesh Patel: thanks — can you call out KMS rotation windows? Lynx has a customer request to avoid KMS changes during their backup window (02:30-03:30).
Emily Nguyen: noted. We will not rotate KMS. This is a model-serving configuration only (version pin + traffic shift). No KMS ops.
Marta Lopez: confirm model pin? which version are we locking to for the Dedicated slice?
Emily Nguyen: pinning to rwd-model-v2.3.1 (quantized int8 fallback). We'll keep rwd-model-v2.4 on standby in the region for rollback.
Owen Chen: rollout plan: canary 2% -> 10% after 15m -> 50% after 30m -> 100% after 60m, with health gates on latency p95 and error-rate.
Sylvia Kim: health gate thresholds: p95 latency <= 350ms, 5xx rate <= 0.5%, token cost variance within 10% of baseline. Also memory GC under 75% host.
deploy-bot: Deploy request queued by @Emily Nguyen. Command: `/deploy canary --tenant=lynx --model=rwd-model-v2.3.1 --slice=dedicated-lynx --traffic=2%`
Rajesh Patel: quick note: please enable KV-prefix caching for common prompt prefixes; Lynx uses a lot of short completions. That reduces cost and stabilizes latency spikes.
Emily Nguyen: KV caching flag enabled in config: `cache_prefix: true, cache_size: 12GB`. Added to the release note.
Marta Lopez: rollback criteria we discussed in runbook: immediate rollback if 5xx > 1% sustained for 5m, or p95 > 500ms for 10m, or accuracy regression on eval prompt set > 2% measured by eval-runner.
Owen Chen: ops procedure: if gate fails, deploy-bot should automatically shift traffic back to rwd-model-v2.2.9 (previous stable) and mark a rollback. @deploy-bot can you confirm fallback target?
deploy-bot: Fallback target set: `rwd-model-v2.2.9`. Auto-fallback policy: `on_gate_fail -> shift 100% -> notify #eng-oncall`.
Sylvia Kim: also add a safety hold: manual approval required before moving from 50% -> 100%. Leave 30-minute manual window to review metrics.
Emily Nguyen: ack — update: manual_hold_after: 50%, hold_duration: 30m. Documented in the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/lynx-switchover-2026-03
Rajesh Patel: one more, DB connections: we need to drain any long-lived inference sessions gracefully. Use `tenant-drain --slice=dedicated-lynx --grace=300s` before shifting >10% traffic.
Marta Lopez: added to checklist. Also note: alerting hooks to pager on increased latency configured: `pager: oncall-sre`.
Owen Chen: can we prime KV cache before traffic ramp? Script attached in thread: ```
# prime_kv.sh
for prompt in $(cat frequent_prompts.txt); do
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/serve -d '{"tenant":"lynx","model":"rwd-model-v2.3.1","input":"'$prompt'"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PRIME_TOKEN'
done
```
Emily Nguyen: nice. I'll run the prime job 20m before canary.
Sylvia Kim: security sign-off: no config changes to KMS or network. Verified. CC: @security
Rajesh Patel: ops sign-off pending from oncall for the quiet window. @Sylvia Kim can you confirm quiet window doesn't conflict?
Sylvia Kim: quiet window check — region maintenance not scheduled. Good to go.
Owen Chen: final checklist summary posted to docs (short): `- model pin v2.3.1; - kv cache enabled; - canary 2/10/50/100; - manual hold at 50%; - rollback rules; - prime before canary; - no KMS rotation; - drain long sessions`.
Emily Nguyen: requesting final approvals: Emily/ops/SRE/security. Reply with :thumbsup: to approve.
Rajesh Patel: :thumbsup: approved (ops).
Marta Lopez: :thumbsup: (release).
Sylvia Kim: :thumbsup: (security).
Owen Chen: :thumbsup: (oncall).
deploy-bot: Deploy started by @Emily Nguyen at 4578912350. Canary traffic 2% applied to dedicated-lynx. Monitoring window started.
Emily Nguyen: thanks team — monitoring dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood/lynx-switchover. Will post updates in this thread during each gate.
deploy-bot: Canary health after 15m: latency p95=318ms, 5xx=0.12%, cost variance +3%. Gate: PASS. Proceeding to 10%
Emily Nguyen: priming job completed 10m before canary; KV fill ~82% of targeted keys.
Owen Chen: 10% -> metrics look stable. Holding 30m at 50% will be manual per plan.
deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 10% at 4578912660. Awaiting manual hold at 50%
Emily Nguyen: bumping thread — manual hold requested at 50% scheduled in ~45m. Please review traces during the hold window.
Rajesh Patel: watching traces, sampling looks good. No spike on tail latency.
Marta Lopez: running eval-runner on prompt set — no measurable regression (<0.5%).
Sylvia Kim: security checks green.
Owen Chen: time to proceed to 50%? I vote go.
Emily Nguyen: proceeding to 50% now. deploy-bot please execute ramp to 50% and hold.
deploy-bot: Manual ramp to 50% executed at 4578913000. Hold active (30m).
deploy-bot: During hold: p95=340ms, 5xx=0.18%, eval delta=+0.2%. Gate: PASS.
Emily Nguyen: proceeding to full 100% after hold. Last chance to veto.
Rajesh Patel: no veto.
Marta Lopez: no veto.
Sylvia Kim: no veto.
Owen Chen: go for it.
deploy-bot: Final traffic shift to 100% executed at 4578913389. All slices reporting healthy. Deployment complete. Release note: "Lynx dedicated slice upgraded to rwd-model-v2.3.1; kv cache enabled; no KMS changes."
Emily Nguyen: thank you all. I'll file the post-deploy short report and close this thread in a few hours if no regressions.
